reviewer: Claude (thread: Phase 0 background replacement), contact sheets at matched timestamps + 1:1 crops

c5-bria-composite.notes: Foreground pixel-exact. Background is the razor-sharp still behind a shallow-focus take; daylight face on a dusk harbor; the office chair was matted out.

c5-switchx-ref.notes: Plate behind a globally relit subject; skin and shirt texture oversharpened; background still sharp; chair matted out.

c5-bfl-video-edit.notes: Best integration (lamp light on face, bokeh) but an invented harbor, not @Harbor (no reference input). 24 fps, 1248x704, 2 frames short.

c5-wan27-edit.notes: @Harbor recognisable, convincing dusk relight; background sharp against a shallow-focus take; face texture re-rendered. 30 fps, duration within a frame.

c5-kling-o1-edit.notes: @Harbor layout, defocused to match the lens; chair kept; subtle relight. Face re-rendered but close (protected PSNR 27.7). 24 fps and 2 frames short.

c5-comfyui-kling.notes: Packaged ComfyUI graph with two references; same quality as the Router run (protected PSNR 27.8), 176 s end to end via the partner-node path.

c5-kling-o1-edit+lock.notes: Source foreground composited over the Kling background with the SwitchX matte, at source fps and length. Clean edges at 1:1; loses Kling's relight, so the face reads as daylight.

c5-aleph2-edit.notes: Reframed: subject smaller and shifted (B4). Face and hair drift; heavy orange relight; generic harbor (text only). Frame-exact timing, 1080p output.

c3-bria-composite.notes: Background is a frozen still while the camera orbits (no parallax). The matte drops the bicycle's front wheel at t=1.2 s and t=3.6 s.

c3-switchx-ref.notes: Generates a moving @Harbor background with parallax that follows the orbit; scoped dusk relight; curly-hair edges clean. Front wheel partly lost around t=3.6 s; some background shimmer.

c3-bfl-video-edit.notes: Invented dusk harbor with parallax, then the original parking lot bleeds back from t=4.8 s; bike frame partly lost. 24 fps, 2 frames short.

c3-wan27-edit.notes: Harbor holds through the whole orbit with plausible parallax; bike and hands intact; dusk relight; face slightly re-rendered. 30 fps.

c3-kling-o1-edit.notes: Opens on the exact @Harbor establishing view and orbits through it, revealing consistent new areas. Bike, hands, jacket logo intact. Little relight: overcast subject on a dusk harbor. 24 fps, 2 frames short.

c3-kling-o1-edit+lock.notes: Source foreground over the Kling background; hair edge clean at 1:1; background slightly sharper than the source lens.

c3-aleph2-edit.notes: Convincing dusk harbor with parallax and lamp rim light, but generic (text only). Frame-exact. Hair texture re-rendered.

c1-comfyui-kling.notes: Backwards track down the @Harbor pier with consistent parallax; passers-by kept as people on the pier (re-rendered). Warm lamp light on both leads, faces close; protected PSNR 20.3 is mostly the relight. 24 fps source, one frame long.

c1-comfyui-kling+lock.notes: Source leads over the Kling background: exact performance and edges, but overcast-daylight leads on a dusk pier read as pasted on; the lock costs most on a strong relight.

c1-comfyui-switchx.notes: Wide @Harbor view that barely moves while the camera tracks backwards (weak parallax). Heavy blue grade recolours the navy jacket toward denim; passers-by removed. Frame-exact.

c2-comfyui-kling.notes: Café becomes the @Greenhouse with sunlit glass roof. The waiter, tray and apron cross in front intact (occlusion handled); cup to lips intact; table kept. Seated extras removed, the second waiter kept. 24 fps source, one frame long.

c2-comfyui-kling+lock.notes: Source leads over the Kling background; sunlit greenhouse is close to the café light, so the lock costs little here.

c2-comfyui-switchx.notes: Greenhouse matches the reference, but red hair turns brown, the wooden table becomes white marble, and the waiter loses the tray and apron while crossing. Frame-exact.

c4-comfyui-kling.notes: Kitchen becomes the sunlit @Greenhouse with the push-in intact; table, lamp, pencil cup and the box hand-off and opening all kept. Leads keep warm lamp light against daylight glass. 25 to 24 fps and 2 source frames short.

c4-comfyui-kling+lock.notes: Source leads and hands over the Kling background at 25 fps and full length; box edges clean; same warm-on-daylight mismatch as the Kling run.

c4-comfyui-switchx.notes: The wooden box becomes a laptop once opened, the polished table becomes rough planks and the lamp disappears: the matte kept only the people, so SwitchX regenerated the handled object. Fails the contact-interaction gate.
